steps.detail: Online backup of prisma/dev.db to dated folder; record SHA-256 and row-count fingerprints (scripts/stage7b-fingerprints.mjs).
For each correction row in v2 manifest, compute live contentHashBefore from production DB (question core hash + lesson JSON hash). Abort if any row differs from manifest without owner approval.
Apply stage7c-hierarchy-fix.v1.json in one transaction; verify 7 reparents; refuse if child parentId unexpected.
Run scripts/stage7c-apply-corrections.mts WITHOUT STAGE7C1_QA_APPLY; STAGE7B_ACK not used — script must refuse production unless separate owner flag added for production apply.
Owner/editor: verifyQuestion(..., VERIFIED) for each allowlist questionId (120), or audited batch with same prepareQuestion gate.
publishLesson(topicId) for each of 10 allowlist topics after readiness passes.
Re-run fingerprints: User/StudyTask/Answer digests unchanged; Stage 6 READY topics unchanged; only allowlist coverage moves DRAFT→READY.

abortConditions: Question or topic outside allowlist would change
Stage 6 READY topic lessonJson or coverage changes
User-table digest changes during content apply
explicitlyForbidden: syncPlan on production for this release
